- **P-01:** Parents reported difficulty explaining lessons in printed modules, supporting consideration of additional explanations for home learning.
- **P-02:** Parent and teacher ratings identified

- **O-01:** Provide a short lesson before each level and display the name and description of each collected rock or mineral.
- **O-02:** Develop four landform episodes covering Mountains, Hills, Plain

This proposed inventory totals 60 levels across four episodes.
- Short lessons before each level, item names and descriptions during collection, and review material after completion.
- Touch controls

The Grades 1–6 survey provides broader context rather than Grade 5-specific findings.
- Content is limited to the four selected landforms and selected related rocks and minerals, rather than all Earth
